observed_error: The live VII GA4 property shows an empty Search Console links table and a disabled create-link control. Opening property access management returns an insufficient-permissions dialog.
diagnosis: The authenticated Adir account can read GA4 property 255021049 and owns the vii.co.il Search Console domain property, but it does not have the GA4 property role required to create a Search Console link.
authorization_boundary: Read-only inspection of the existing VII Google properties and local implementation work. No access request, permission change, new account, property or container was submitted.

routes.evidence: No installed connector exposes Google Analytics or Search Console administration.

The signed-in Google session reads V FOR VACATION / vii.co.il - GA4 and sc-domain:vii.co.il, but GA4 property access management reports insufficient permissions and the create-link control is disabled.
The project contains no authorized Google Analytics Admin API credentials or OAuth configuration; no secret was inferred or created.
Google Analytics requires a property role with link-management permission before the Search Console integration can be created.

minimum_human_action: A GA4 property administrator must grant djskabi@gmail.com an Editor role, or create the Search Console link for property 255021049 to sc-domain:vii.co.il.
resume_when: The GA4 Search Console links page enables the create-link control or shows the completed vii.co.il link.
